title: Shinytableau package : "Log in to see this content" error
description:
Hello All,

I have followed all the steps mentioned in the article for creating extensions for Tableau using Shiny. I deployed shinytableau extension to our internal RConnect server. However I was not able to connect the trex file downloaded from RConnect. It keeps on saying "Log in to see this content" in Tableau after I read trex file.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/87191421/164557309-61966b6e-6447-48ed-8c9b-25e221c6bafb.png)
It never logs me in the Tableau after I click on Log in button. A separate webpage opens up and asks for credentials and it logs me in the RConnect server but not in Tableau

title: tableau_manifest_from_yaml doesn't support "source_location"
description:
The source location argument needs to be added to the return value with  `tableau_manifest`:

```diff

tableau_manifest(extension_id = y$extension_id, extension_version = y$extension_version, 
    name = y$name, description = y$description, extended_description = y$extended_description, 
    author_name = y$author_name, author_email = y$author_email, 
    author_organization = y$author_organization, website = y$website, 
    icon_file = path_icon_file, permissions = y$permissions, 
    min_api_version = y$min_api_version, 
+   source_location = y$source_location)
```

title: CRAN Release
description:
Good day,

I was wondering if there are plans to make a CRAN release for shinytableau? In many organisations, including where I work in, IT doesn't allow to use github packages in the environment. We use RStudio Connect but I can't deploy my extensions there because shinytableau isn't on CRAN.

Thanks in advance,

Denis Abdullin

title: Reactive data doesn't 'react' to Tableau filters
description:
Hello, I've been using the package a lot recently and the only major pain point is that the **reactive data and extension output don't change when I change selection in Tableau filters**.  I made a workaround in Tableau adding a button that has to be clicked to trigger Tableau Actions, but this not great for users as they have to make additional click (they should also know that this click is needed to update the extension output).

Do I miss something or this is not yet part of the package functionality?

Thanks in advance!

Denis
